en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to apprize students with basic chemical calculations, the mastery of which is the basis for further study of related subjects in the chemical field. The student will use the acquired knowledge in chemical analysis when preparing an experiment and evaluating experimental data.
